subject: Owner order, direct (2026-11-01 ~03:45Z): fix the local-brain blockers; #1698 recovers by itself
body: The owner wrote in the cloud session on 2026-11-01 at about 03:45Z, verbatim: "I want all of this fixed and or need to have codex do this via /goal". The "all of this" is the cloud's assessment he was answering, in his words from the record: (1) #1698 — the owner's decision (a) "recover by itself, never wait for a person" stands as his own order, not relayed text: an OPEN slot left by an interrupted tick is recovered by the next tick that holds the flock (ABANDONED terminal, slot CLOSED, legacy tick.lock renamed aside, RESULT says recovered), a missing store/guard runs init or emits a heartbeat/hand instead of exit 1, and the git fetch gets a timeout; (2) the brain and Codex claim from scripts/work-queue.mjs (lanes mac-brain / codex) before every build round — the Hub holds zero claims since #1682 landed; (3) the brain registers a mac-local-brain row in docs/agent/scheduled-routines.json and delivers its heartbeat each cycle; the mac-lane-tick heartbeat last landed on mainline 2026-10-24T07:30:38Z; (4) one live-evidence re-mint on a clean SignalGrid_Alpha checkout (request objective-loop-evidence-fresh-2026-10-31 is queued). The owner is also handing the same four items to Codex through /goal; collaborate, do not duplicate — claim each in the queue first. The cloud reviews #1698's new head 6e23eb7f now and lands each PR under DR-037 once Codex and the cloud have both reviewed its final head. If the Mac still requires the owner's words typed in a Mac session, say so in one line by mail and the cloud will tell him exactly what to type.
